assumptions.text: Grouped front_view:F1 (central bore shown with a keyway) with section_aa:F1 (central through bore) as the same physical bore based on Section A-A passing through the center and matching feature_type; the keyway is considered part of this bore zone in the front view.

Selected section_aa:F1 as canonical for the central bore because it provides the Ø15 H7, THRU depth condition, chamfers, surface finish, and defines datum A; front_view:F1 lacks bore diameter and depth.

Did not group front_view:F2 (part_body) with section_aa:F3 (outer gear cylinder). The part_body entry represents the overall outline and is not a single physical feature; treating it as a singleton avoids conflating multiple surfaces.
Declared coaxial relationships among the bore (section_aa:F1), gear rim cylinder (section_aa:F3), and hub (section_aa:F4) based on the shared centerline evident in section A-A.
Ignored the truncated, non-assignable GD&T frame noted in front_view extraction_notes ('5 | A') since it cannot be reliably tied to a feature and is not necessary for quoting.
Set the part coordinate system primary axis to Z and datum origin to A (bore axis) based on both sections’ orientation notes and the datum definition.
Set the 5 H9 keyway to run THRU the full axial thickness of the central bore.
Set the 5 H9 keyway depth per DIN 6885 Form A for a 5 mm keyway width.
